meta.titulo: The Lobster Roll Barcelona · Canadian lobster on a brioche bun, at Muntaner 22
meta.descripcion: The Lobster Roll, in L'Esquerra de l'Eixample, two minutes from Universitat metro. Canadian lobster rolls, crab rolls, combos and a terrace. Book online.
meta.og_descripcion: Canadian lobster on a brioche bun. The only restaurant in Barcelona serving East Coast American food.

hero.bajada: Canadian lobster on a brioche bun. The only restaurant in Barcelona serving East Coast American food.

restaurante.cita: Our speciality is the Lobster Roll, made only with Canadian lobster.
restaurante.p1: We're in L'Esquerra de l'Eixample, steps from Universitat metro. Walk in and you'll find a very large, long dining room with a modern look.
restaurante.p2: The whole room is full of plants. Lamps of every style hang from the ceiling and give a great light. And we have a terrace, with several tables.
restaurante.p3: We're the only restaurant in Barcelona serving East Coast American food. Beyond lobster rolls, we make crab rolls with brown crab or shrimp, and pulled pork or beef rolls.

bloque.b_desc: Same brioche bun with more meat.

carta.intro: Short lines, big rolls. Names kept just as the house calls them.

combos.texto: Every combo comes with a roll, a drink and a mochi.

fotos.texto: A long dining room full of plants, and a terrace on Muntaner.
